name: BDACS KRW1
collateral: 1:1 South Korean won held in escrow at Woori Bank with real-time banking-API proof of reserves
pegMechanism: Custodian-managed mint/redemption against KRW deposits at Woori Bank; KRW1 is a brand trademarked by BDACS (December 2023) and operated by BDACS as the regulated digital asset custodian

jurisdiction.regulator: FSC / FSS (Digital Asset Basic Act pending)

launchPhaseDetail: Pilot phase following successful September 2025 proof of concept; not yet in public circulation. BDACS is South Korea's regulated digital-asset custodian; Woori Bank holds the won reserves and participated directly in the PoC. Initial deployment on Avalanche (cited by KISA for reliability in public-sector use); multi-chain expansion planned. February 2026 Plume partnership positions KRW1 as Korean institutional settlement rail for tokenized RWA. Commercial launch contingent on Korea's forthcoming Digital Asset Basic Act framework where BDACS is positioning KRW1 as the leading technical standard.
